mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening supply side, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS > 3-month MA and UNRATE < 3-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 < 0 for 2 consecutive quarters.
